items.q: He's good, good. Yeah, yeah, George. He's doing anything. When he first started playing, he was a little boy with Harvard. Uncle Luke, super big as that. Used to play that with his dad.

ctx.x: That's from Donaldsonville, yeah. Old man, uh, Clayborne Williams. Yeah, that'd be Clayborne Williams. He died when his son still played. He played in Baton Rouge. But he still played Dixieland music. Clayborne? Yeah, old man Clayborne's been there.
